claim: A scripted edit can silently miss (different leading whitespace); check the full-layer result by compositing the real palette, attributes and patterns, and keep the old build as the negative.

evidence.text: The Enhanced setup substitution silently missed because its leading whitespace differed, leaving NR4B0 and making intended black0 transparent; compositing the actual native palette, attributes and patterns exposed the lost ink pixels; keep the old build as the negative.
evidence.quote: The Enhanced setup substitution silently missed because its leading whitespace differed, leaving NR4B0
